g01.line: Welcome to planet Maya, Captain. I'm Sergeant Wilhelm of Merchant Corp.
g01.speaker: Wilhelm

g02.line: I know you're coming to our planet for the first time, and your skills will come in handy.
g02.speaker: Wilhelm

g03.line: Here at Merchant Corp, we gather resources like lumber, oil, and other rare resources, then sell them to people on other planets.
g03.speaker: Wilhelm

g04.line: However, it's getting harder to find these resources. That's why we need you to help us.
g04.speaker: Wilhelm

g05.line: We've just found Fortuna. No team has explored it.
g05.speaker: Wilhelm

g06.line: It's far from our main base. It may have oil, gold, and useful wood. But storms and wild animals may make the trip dangerous.
g06.speaker: Wilhelm VO

g07.line: Explore Fortuna and report what you find. If the resources are there and the site is safe, we'll ask you to build a base and start collecting them.
g07.speaker: Wilhelm

g08.line: You'll lead your own crew, build your own base, and get ten percent of the profit after costs. That's the money left after costs. Will you take the mission?
g08.speaker: Wilhelm

n15.line: You want more? All right. Fifteen percent. Do we have a deal?
n15.speaker: Wilhelm

n20.line: Again? Twenty percent. That's my final offer.
n20.speaker: Wilhelm

c01.line: We have a deal. Meet Rho, your first mate.
c01.speaker: Wilhelm

c02.line: I'm Rho, your first mate. I'll help you learn about Maya and Fortuna, and guide you along the way.
c02.speaker: Rho

c04.line: Crew ready. The path is clear.
c04.speaker: Rho

c07.line: That storm is moving fast. Turn back!
c07.speaker: Rho

c09.line: The engine's on fire! We're losing power!
c09.speaker: Rho

c10.line: Crew, get ready! Captain, pull the blue handle!
c10.speaker: Rho

c14.line: The crew is scattered. We can't reach the base. You're still the captain. Find the crew. Build a camp. We'll rebuild the ship. I'll help you learn to lead.
c14.speaker: Rho

c15.line: One day, you could lead a space empire. First, let's get your crew home.
c15.speaker: Rho

c16.line: Start with the wreck. What food and tools can we save?
c16.speaker: Rho
